title: Internal: Backend Incident 11/14 - Erroneous Credit Bureau Reporting
summary: Protocol for Backend Incident 11/14/2025–11/18/2025 (active through 11:59 PM EST) covers erroneous delinquency reports sent to credit bureaus for certain credit card accounts in good standing. Reports can include sudden alerts/notifications and credit score drops of often 80–150 points; identity verification is NOT required and requires immediate escalation using emergency_credit_bureau_incident_transfer_1114() then transfer_to_human_agents.
